referenceAnswers: I took a breath and told Mrs Chen what I had done. She listened without interrupting, then opened the order book. “Let's call them before they cut it,” she said. I explained the mistake to Mr Lewis while she checked the other order. Fortunately, he was still nearby. He brought the unopened box back, and I checked both labels with Mrs Chen before handing him the lemon cake. My hands were shaking, but the two orders were finally correct. When the family returned later that afternoon, I was still expecting angry words. Instead, Mr Lewis smiled and showed me a photograph of the celebration. His mother had enjoyed the lemon cake, and he wanted to thank us for sorting out the problem so quickly. I started to apologise again, but he pointed to the order book. “You used it when it mattered,” he said. After they left, I checked the next label slowly, reading the name aloud.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 同一任务两段合约150词；段首已给，不需要在作答框再次输入。完整参考、冲突处理与修订反例见下方。

author_notes:
一完整续写任务、两给定段首、两段合约150词，不拆两题或两段各150。源未明确段首计词是否排除，本文参考同时报告含段首与新增正文数量，不借其他卷口径；约数不是私造精确区间。源明示25分不等已得分析rubric。

作者关注：保留第一人称/过去叙事、两盒蛋糕和订单本的线索；第一段主动告知并合理解决调换，第二段衔接family returned与叙述者预期；不能让所有错误凭空消失或由客户主动不明就里地解决。结尾行动体现改变即可，不必喊口号。

### 未评分参考续文

本参考实际计量：新增正文132词，给定段首25词，合计157词。源段首是否排除未明示，此处同时披露，不据此伪造精确合格区间。

I took a breath and told Mrs Chen what I had done. She listened without interrupting, then opened the order book. “Let's call them before they cut it,” she said. I explained the mistake to Mr Lewis while she checked the other order. Fortunately, he was still nearby. He brought the unopened box back, and I checked both labels with Mrs Chen before handing him the lemon cake. My hands were shaking, but the two orders were finally correct.

When the family returned later that afternoon, I was still expecting angry words. Instead, Mr Lewis smiled and showed me a photograph of the celebration. His mother had enjoyed the lemon cake, and he wanted to thank us for sorting out the problem so quickly. I started to apologise again, but he pointed to the order book. “You used it when it mattered,” he said. After they left, I checked the next label slowly, reading the name aloud.

### 待修订反例

如果第一段写“我把剩下蛋糕卖掉，隐瞒错误”，第二段只写家属无缘无故赞美我，则没有解决两订单的冲突，也缺少与段首预期的因果桥。问题在叙事一致性，不因是否使用某个高级词来决定。
